entities.summary: Karin Margareta Ahrland, née Andersson was a Swedish politician, diplomat, lawyer, and activist. She was a member of parliament from 1976 to 1989. She began as a trained lawyer after earning her law degree in 1958, working in courts and county administrative boards, and later serving in the Supreme Administrative Court. Throughout the 1960s and 1970s, she built a strong legal-administrative career within Swedish public administration.
